checker: cd lean-mathlib && lake env lean Proofs/ZenoProofMarket.lean
claim: Formalizes the exact ZenoProof proof-market boundary: proof mining and posted proof demand instantiate a primary proof-demand market only when demand, escrowed budget, verified proof supply, canonical consumed-set deduplication, and settlement gates are present. A full user-to-user proof exchange additionally requires transferable receipts.
non_claims: Does not prove legal compliance or securities status.
Does not prove verifier soundness, cryptographic security, proof availability, market liquidity, or runtime liveness.
Does not prove that a full secondary proof exchange exists without transferable receipt rules.
Does not prove mathematical truth of accepted work without an explicit verifier-soundness assumption.
Does not prove concrete runtime fields instantiate every abstract theorem assumption.
